description: Interactive neutral chip. A pill-shaped button with a binary selected look, 2 sizes, leading/trailing icon slots and an optional corner badge. Unlike ChipBadgeLike (a display <span> with an optional close button), ChipUniversal is a real <button> — used for filter toggles, dropdown triggers and quick-select rows. The toggle semantics are the consumer's: the component only paints `selected`.
_comment_figmaNode: Retro-extracted from source (/retro-spec). No Figma node ID for ChipUniversal is recorded anywhere in the repo, so it is left null rather than guessed. Fill it together with figmaFileKey (the other specs use 3ZDIVn83opF9OYSzWYE1iF) once confirmed in Figma.

variantMetadata._comment: CHIP_UNIVERSAL_SIZES is declared in src/components/Chip/shared.tsx and re-exported from ChipUniversal.tsx, so both import paths resolve to the same array. CHIP_UNIVERSAL_PURPOSES is declared in ChipUniversal.tsx itself — nothing else in the Chip folder uses it. `purpose` is not a CVA axis: it changes ARIA attributes only, never the paint. There is no shape axis — the chip is always rounded-full.

selected.description: Visual selection state. Drives the CVA `selected` variant, and is emitted as aria-pressed (purpose='toggle'), aria-expanded (purpose='trigger') or nothing at all (purpose='action'). Toggle/dropdown behaviour is the consumer's job via onClick. If the painted selection and the popup's open state differ, pass aria-expanded explicitly — the trailing spread wins.

purpose.description: What the chip is used for. Splits the ARIA state attribute: toggle → aria-pressed, trigger → aria-expanded + aria-haspopup='true', action → neither. The default preserves the pre-split behaviour (aria-pressed always emitted). `action` exists because asChild + <a href> makes the element a link, and role=link does not allow aria-pressed.

iconLeading.description: Leading icon slot. Sized internally from the size variant.

iconTrailing.description: Trailing icon slot. Sits outside the inner icon+text group, so the outer gap applies to it.

badgeLabel.description: Corner badge content. Rendered as BadgeLabel size='nano' shape='circular' weight='heavy' color='red', absolutely positioned at the top-right. Named badgeLabel (not badge) per docs/ANATOMY.md A5 — a Badge carries content, a Dot does not, and SegmentBar.Item / Tab.Item use badgeDot: boolean for the dot.

asChild.description: Radix Slot — renders the child element with the chip styles. type='button' is dropped when asChild is set. children must be a single React element. The consumer's element is wrapped in <Slottable> so the ring/overlay/badge spans can be siblings of it; without that, Radix's React.Children.only threw on every asChild render. The content wrapper does not exist on this path, so the root carries the gap (see implementation.domStructure).

disabled.description: Native button disabled attribute plus pointer-events-none and opacity-50. Inherited from ButtonHTMLAttributes, not declared explicitly.

children.description: Label content. Wrapped in a span with px-1 (4px each side) on the default path. With asChild it must be a single React element, it is passed through <Slottable>, and it gets no wrapper — so no px-1.

...rest.description: 'color' is omitted to avoid colliding with the HTML color attribute. Spread last, so a consumer can override the purpose-derived aria attributes (aria-pressed / aria-expanded / aria-haspopup) or type.

large.gap: 6px → --comp-chip-universal-gap-lg (primitive-spacing-1.5) — between the icon+text group and iconTrailing

shape._comment: No shape prop. rounded-full is hardcoded in the CVA base string and repeated on the focus ring and state overlay spans. There is no --comp-chip-universal-radius-* token.

pressed.scale: active:scale-[var(--comp-chip-universal-scale-pressed)] → --semantic-scale-press-lg → --primitive-scale-99 → 0.99. The transition is composed inline: --comp-scale-press-transition-out on release, -in on press, sharing the list with the colour transition.

focused.all: border-2 border-[var(--comp-chip-universal-focus-border)] (semantic-neutral-solid-1000) on a dedicated rounded-full span, shown on group-focus-visible only.
focused.note: This token read var(--semantic-primary-300) until Phase 2 — a family that never existed, so the ring fell back to currentColor. It now matches the Button/Tab/ChipBadgeLike/NavVertical convention (neutral-solid-1000).

disabled.description: pointer-events-none + opacity-50, plus the native disabled attribute on the <button>. No separate disabled colour tokens — unlike Button, the chip dims rather than recolouring.

states.loading: N/A — ChipUniversal has no loading state or spinner.

a11y.role: native: <button type='button'>. With asChild the element is whatever the consumer renders, and no role is imposed on it — use purpose='action' there when it is a link, since role=link forbids aria-pressed.

keyboard.Tab: Sequential — one tab stop, in DOM order. A chip row is plain DOM, not a composite widget.
keyboard.Arrow: N/A — a standalone control with no group semantics. Roving focus would require a wrapper this component does not provide.

a11y.focusVisible: Custom ring only: the CVA base sets outline-none, and an absolute <span aria-hidden> with border-2 rounded-full fades in on group-focus-visible (transition-opacity duration-fast ease-enter).
gaps: aria-haspopup is emitted as 'true' (menu) for every trigger, because the chip cannot know whether the popup is a menu, a listbox or a dialog. A consumer whose popup is not a menu must pass the exact value through the trailing spread.
badgeLabel renders BadgeLabel, a plain <span> with no aria-hidden, so its number is folded into the button's accessible name with no unit (e.g. '필터 3'). Compare BadgeDot, which is aria-hidden.

With asChild, `disabled` is forwarded to the Slot child. On a non-button child it has no effect, leaving only pointer-events-none and opacity-50 — the element stays focusable and Enter still activates it.

implementation.stateOverlay: Single absolute <span aria-hidden> inset-0 rounded-full. The hover/active token pair is chosen in JS from `selected` rather than with group-data attributes, because the chip has no data-state.
implementation.focusRing: Separate absolute <span aria-hidden> with border-2, opacity toggled by group-focus-visible. No pointerRef — unlike Button, this relies on the CSS :focus-visible pseudo-class alone.
implementation.iconSizing: One renderIcon() helper builds both paths' containers: size-[var(--comp-chip-universal-icon-{lg|md})] plus flex-shrink-0 and [&>*]:[font-size:inherit], with style={{ fontSize: iconFontSizeVar[size] }}. iconFontSizeVar holds 'var(--comp-chip-universal-icon-{lg|md})', matching the Button family — the previous raw numbers (18 / 16) duplicated the token values in JS.
implementation.badgePosition: Absolute -top-1 -right-1 (−4px) z-[2] wrapper. Sits outside the content span, so it is unaffected by the content gaps.
implementation.asChild: Slot + Slottable. The three content expressions (leading icon, <Slottable>{children}</Slottable>, trailing icon) are top-level siblings of Slot because Radix finds the Slottable with React.Children.toArray(children).find(isSlottable) — one level only, so a Fragment or wrapper span hides it and React.Children.only throws again. Since the content wrapper is gone on that path, the root takes gapMap[size]; iconLeading↔text spacing matches the default path (inner-gap + px-1 == gap), while text↔iconTrailing loses the 4px px-1. The consumer's content also has no z-[1] wrapper, so the hover/press overlay paints over it — the tints are 5-8% alpha, so this is accepted rather than worked around.
domStructure: button (root: bg, height, px, rounded-full, group relative, outline-none, press scale; + gap when asChild)
span (focus ring: absolute inset-0, rounded-full, border-2, group-focus-visible)
span (state overlay: absolute inset-0, rounded-full, group-hover/group-active)
span (content: relative z-1, inline-flex, outer gap)
span (badge wrapper: absolute -top-1 -right-1 z-2, conditional) → BadgeLabel
domStructureAsChild: <consumer element> (root: same classes + gap; Slot injects the children below into it)

tokenNotes.literals: --comp-chip-universal-icon-lg (18px), --comp-chip-universal-icon-md (16px) and --comp-chip-universal-inner-gap-md (0px) are px literals with no primitive reference. 16px has an equal-valued --primitive-spacing-4 and 0px has --primitive-spacing-0; 18px has no primitive counterpart (the spacing scale steps 16 → 20).
tokenNotes.missing: No radius token — rounded-full is written directly into three class strings.
